author: DamiLee
description:
Someone emailed me a pyramid theory I almost deleted. He had 10 years of research behind it, and what he said stopped me cold: the pyramids weren't built. They were unbuilt.

The ramps, the tools, the missing evidence we've spent 4,000 years searching for? He says it's not missing at all. It's sitting right in front of us, just misinterpreted.

I won't pretend I wasn't skeptical. The line between pyramid researcher and conspiracy theorist gets blurry fast. But the work was serious, and the idea is one I haven't been able to shake since.

For everything we've simulated, excavated, and theorized across four millennia of speculation, we still know shockingly little about how these structures were actually built. That gap is either embarrassing or a clue. Maybe both.

Comment "Pyramid" if you want to go deeper. Full video is up now.

title: The Pyramids Weren't Built. They Were Unbuilt.
